incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 5xx rate from Dedicated GPU pool 'dedicated-europe-1' affecting streaming/text-generation endpoints. Autoscaler firing and recent node evictions observed. Paging on-call now.

maria (oncall): ack. jumping in. first look at logs now.

ajay: on it too. I see OOM eviction events on the nodes, kernel oom_killer triggered ~09:12 UTC. Also a spike in concurrent KV cache size.

maria (oncall): svc health shows ~12% 5xx across streaming endpoints for last 5m. Rolling fallback to smaller model variant started automatically for some requests.

chris: confirming client-side retries are causing some retry storms. We should throttle retries at gateway for affected routes asap.

maria (oncall): mitigations: 1) scale up dedicated pool by +3 instances (in progress) 2) enable fallback routing to hosted pool for heavy tail clients 3) add temporary request rate limit to streaming route.

eng-sre-bot: scale up completed at 09:21 UTC. New instances booting.

ajay: adding a quick patch to routing policy to prefer hosted fallback for non-SLA customers. pushing now.

janet (support): heads-up: customer "SynthLabs" reported errors in calls to real-time transcripts. They see ~15% errors over last 20m. Notified account team.

olivia (pm): what's the user-visible impact? is it graceful degradation (slower) or hard errors?

maria (oncall): mostly hard 5xx during eviction windows. Fallback gives successful responses but with higher latency and lower throughput for some features.

chris: I've added a temporary retry-debounce on the ingress proxy: retries spaced to 2s and capped at 2. That cut downstream thrash in logs.

ajay: post-scaling and routing change, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% in the last 5m. Still watching for regressions.

maria (oncall): keeping pager open for 30m post-stable. filing postmortem and action items now.

incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-2093456789. Severity: P2 (customer-impact). Bridge: follow-up async.

olivia (pm): please schedule a postmortem meeting. Owners: ajay (root cause analysis), chris (ingress/rate-limits), maria (oncall timeline), janet (customer comms). Preferred window: tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

ajay: preliminary RCA: autoscaler + memory pressure from large KV caches triggered eviction cascade; eviction led to process restarts and rapid failover. Gateway retries amplified load causing more evictions.

chris: root causes: 1) paging thresholds allowed immediate page on a brief spike, 2) no debounce on platform-level retries, 3) no synthetic canary to detect mem pressure on dedicated pools.

maria (oncall): proposed immediate action items (short-term):
- add OOM eviction metric to alerting and suppress noisy paging for single-node spikes
- add 3-minute sustained window to paging rule before paging primary on-call
- add a debounce on applicable retries at gateway

chris: proposed alert expression (Prometheus) to replace current alert:

```
alert: DedicatedPoolHigh5xxSustained
expr: |
  (sum(rate(requests_total{job=\"streaming\",status=~\"5..\"}[1m]))
   / sum(rate(requests_total{job=\"streaming\"}[1m])))
   > 0.02
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: \"Sustained 5xx >2% for streaming routes (3m)\"
```

olivia (pm): longer-term actions:
- add synthetic memory-pressure canaries to dedicated pools
- revisit autoscaler OOM mitigation strategy + lower eviction priority for inference processes
- run a chaos test for node evictions in staging
- update SLOs/alerting runbook to include customer-impact thresholds and paging filters

janet (support): I'll prepare customer-facing timeline and notify impacted accounts with mitigations and ETA for postmortem.

maria (oncall): scheduling: postmortem set for 2026-05-20 14:00 UTC. I'll create the doc and add action tracker with owners/due dates.

eng-sre-bot: Created issue RED-INC-2093456789 in tracking board: \"Dedicated pool evictions -> retry storm -> paging noise\". Assigned to ajay. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/RED-INC-2093456789

ajay: action items I'm taking:
- (P0) instrument KV cache metrics per model + threshold alerts (due 5/25)
- (P1) add eviction metric to paging filter and adjust alert for sustained window (due 5/21)
- (P1) run a load test with retry backoff scenarios in staging (due 6/1)

chris: my action items:
- (P0) implement ingress retry-debounce and cap (deploy by 5/20 EOD)
- (P1) add a Grafana dashboard for evictions + rpc/retry correlation (due 5/28)

maria (oncall): I'll follow up on postmortem doc and customer comms. Also propose we change paging to only page on sustained cross-node evictions or multi-customer impact.

olivia (pm): agree. Also let's add an entries to the Runbook: \"When paging from eviction metrics, confirm customer-impact via support dashboard before paging primary. If <3% overall and single-customer, page infra-oncall instead.\"

janet (support): adding a support playbook snippet for communications and P0 contact list.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll close this thread when postmortem doc + tracker is ready. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre-bot: Incident marked stable at 09:44 UTC. Monitoring will continue for 2h.

maria (oncall): closing pager. postmortem invite sent.
